parts.t: Mobile and manufactured home parks are another way to own a home in Langley. In the parks below, you buy the home and pay a monthly pad fee to the park. Some parks are age-restricted (55+) and others welcome all ages, and each park sets its own pet rules. This guide lists six Langley parks with the address, age rule and pet rule for each, taken from recent MLS® listings.

blocks.text: Langley Mobile Home Parks: 55+ and All-Ages

parts.t: These four parks are in south Langley, near the commercial area at 200 Street and 24 Avenue, which has a grocery store, pub and gas station.
An age-restricted manufactured home community near the shops at 200 Street and 24 Avenue.
An age-restricted manufactured home community on 196 Street, close to the grocery store and pub at 200 Street and 24 Avenue.
Pets: allowed with limits on number and size (an earlier listing noted two cats or one small dog)
An age-restricted manufactured home community with a bus stop at the park entrance. Shops, restaurants and Campbell Valley Park are about 1 km away.
Pets: one pet allowed, with restrictions (a recent listing noted one cat or one dog up to 14 inches / 12 lb)
An age-restricted manufactured home community with a clubhouse, near the shops at 200 Street and 24 Avenue.
All-Ages Mobile Home Parks in Langley
These two parks have no age restriction.
A manufactured home park on Fraser Highway in Aldergrove, close to transit, shops and restaurants.
Pets: up to two cats or dogs, with restrictions (a recent listing noted a 16-inch size limit)
A treed, campground-style park in the Salmon River area, a few minutes from Highway 1.
Pets: cats and dogs allowed, with restrictions

Each park sets its own rules, and they can change. The age and pet rules above come from recent MLS® listings. Always confirm them with the park before you buy. Please confirm current rules and pad fees with the park manager before you write an offer.
